caseName: Georgia State Board of Examiners of Optometry v. Mott
caseNameFull: Georgia State Board of Examiners of Optometry v. Kennon Mott
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Georgia.
attorneys: Mr. James K. Hines for plaintiffs in error. Mr. Owens Johnson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction upon the authority of .§ 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726. See Marshall v. Dye, 231 U. S. 250; Stewart v. Kansas City, 239 U. S. 14.
